physical_harmonic_oscillator_ode.differential_equation: m * x_ddot + c * x_dot + k * x = 0
physical_harmonic_oscillator_ode.standard_form: x_ddot + 2 * zeta * omega_n * x_dot + omega_n^2 * x = 0

mass_m.description: Virtual inertial mass of viewport content

stiffness_k.description: Elastic Hookean boundary restitution spring coefficient

damping_c.description: Viscous fluid drag resistance opposing velocity

damping_ratio.formula: zeta = c / c_c = c / (2 * sqrt(k * m))
damping_ratio.damping_regime_classification: zeta < 1.0 (sub-critical damping produces gentle rubber-band bounce before settling)

underdamped_solver.position_formula: x(t) = e^(-gamma * t) * (A * cos(omega_d * t) + B * sin(omega_d * t))
underdamped_solver.position_formula_latex: x(t) = e^{-\gamma t} \left( x_0 \cos(\omega_d t) + \frac{v_0 + \gamma x_0}{\omega_d} \sin(\omega_d t) \right)
underdamped_solver.velocity_formula: v(t) = e^(-gamma * t) * (v_0 * cos(omega_d * t) - ((gamma * v_0 + omega_n^2 * x_0) / omega_d) * sin(omega_d * t))
underdamped_solver.velocity_formula_latex: \dot{x}(t) = e^{-\gamma t} \left( v_0 \cos(\omega_d t) - \frac{\gamma v_0 + \omega_n^2 x_0}{\omega_d} \sin(\omega_d t) \right)

critically_damped_solver.position_formula: x(t) = e^(-omega_n * t) * (x_0 + (v_0 + omega_n * x_0) * t)
critically_damped_solver.position_formula_latex: x(t) = e^{-\omega_n t} \left( x_0 + (v_0 + \omega_n x_0) t \right)
critically_damped_solver.velocity_formula: v(t) = e^(-omega_n * t) * (v_0 - omega_n * (v_0 + omega_n * x_0) * t)

overdamped_solver.roots: mu_1 = -gamma + omega_n * sqrt(zeta^2 - 1), mu_2 = -gamma - omega_n * sqrt(zeta^2 - 1)

settling_and_termination_criteria.velocity_aware_settling_duration_formula: t_settle = -ln(epsilon / X_max) / (zeta * omega_n) where X_max = sqrt(x_0^2 + ((v_0 + gamma * x_0) / omega_d)^2)
settling_and_termination_criteria.critically_damped_settling_formula: t_settle = Newton-Raphson root of ln(|x_0 + (v_0 + omega_n * x_0)*t|) - omega_n * t - ln(epsilon) = 0
settling_and_termination_criteria.overdamped_settling_formula: t_settle = -ln(epsilon / max(|C_1|, epsilon)) / (gamma - omega_d) where omega_d = omega_n * sqrt(zeta^2 - 1)
settling_and_termination_criteria.duration_for_epsilon_method: -[CASpringAnimation durationForEpsilon:] computes analytical settling time for arbitrary client-specified epsilon threshold
settling_and_termination_criteria.sub_epsilon_settling_rule: If initialDisplacement <= epsilon (0.001 pt) and initialVelocity == 0, the system has already settled and t_settle returns 0.0 without evaluating logarithms
settling_and_termination_criteria.cadisplaylink_integration: Stepped via CADisplayLink callback _UIScrollViewSpringDisplayLinkTick using displayLink.targetTimestamp

comparison_analytical_vs_numerical.numerical_rk4_rejected_rationale: Runge-Kutta 4th Order (RK4) requires 4 evaluations per frame, introduces cumulative phase error on variable ProMotion timesteps, and cannot easily compute settling times without forward stepping.
comparison_analytical_vs_numerical.numerical_euler_rejected_rationale: Explicit Euler suffers catastrophic numerical instability for stiff springs when dt > 2 / omega_n; Semi-implicit Euler introduces artificial energy damping.
analytical_solution_advantages: Exact mathematical precision for arbitrary continuous timestamp t = timestamp - startTimestamp
100% immune to frame rate fluctuation across 60Hz, 80Hz, 120Hz
Unconditionally stable under all initial conditions

methods.role: Computes settling duration to epsilon threshold
